Batch endpoint correctly handles empty requests and >50 order limit
Frontend correctly calls batch endpoint for first 20 orders

Orders without crew data show 'Kein Personal definiert' with manual edit button
Week navigation triggers crew data reload for new week's orders
Shift assignment creation/deletion working via grid cells
Manual edit form working with order dropdown, role, time, and note fields

context_for_next_testing_agent: EpiRent Crewbrain integration tested.
